mismatches.question: Is my cargo covered for accidental physical loss or damage during transit?
mismatches.rationale: Clause 1 (p.1) is an all-risks insuring clause expressly 'except as provided in Clauses 4, 5, 6 and 7 below'.

mismatches.question: Is loss caused by war, capture or seizure of the carrying vessel covered?
mismatches.rationale: Clause 6 (p.1) excludes war, civil war, capture/seizure, etc.
